meta.name: changelog-maintenance
meta.description: Maintain comprehensive changelogs and release notes following Keep a Changelog format. Use when documenting version history, release notes, or tracking changes across versions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按规范维护版本变更日志和发布说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目维护结构化的版本变更日志。
copy.tagline_en: Maintain version changelogs and release notes in standard format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain structured changelogs for your project.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会按照Keep a Changelog格式和语义化版本规则，帮你创建和维护项目的CHANGELOG.md文件。它会将变更分类为新增、变更、弃用、移除、修复和安全等，并自动生成发布说明。
howto.when: 当你要记录版本历史、编写发布说明或追踪版本间的变更时，Claude会接管。例如，你要求“为这次更新写发布说明”或“生成CHANGELOG”时触发。

say.note: Claude会输出一个结构化的CHANGELOG条目。
Claude会在[Fixed]部分添加一条记录。

say.text: 按照Keep a Changelog格式整理这些版本变更。
say.note: Claude会重新组织你提供的变更内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create and maintain your project's CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format and semantic versioning. It categorizes changes into Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security, and generates release notes automatically.
howto.when_en: When you need to document version history, write release notes, or track changes across versions. For example, when you ask 'generate release notes for this update' or 'create a CHANGELOG'.

say_en.note: Claude will output a structured CHANGELOG entry.

say_en.text: Update the CHANGELOG with the bug fix.
say_en.note: Claude will add a record under Fixed.

say_en.text: Format these releases in Keep a Changelog style.
say_en.note: Claude will reorganize your changes accordingly.
